title: 9/11 as a diversion from disclosure

tellings.quote: And then 911 happened. happened a few months later as a direct consequence

plain: Steven Greer, a campaigner who wants governments to reveal what they know about UFOs, says the September 11 attacks of 2001 happened "a few months later as a direct consequence" of a push for that kind of disclosure earlier the same year. He gives this as his own reading, without naming a source, and he means that the attacks pulled the world's attention away from the UFO question.
